main.description: A declaration of the default site for an organization

uploadedBy.description: DID of the signed-in account that created this record, stamped at write time by the GainForest app. Meaningful when it differs from the repo owner — an organization member acting on the organization's behalf. Optional: records written before this field existed, or outside the app, omit it.

site.description: The reference to the default site record in the PDS

createdAt.description: The date and time of the creation of the record
